meaning:
ὁποῖος, -οία, -οῖον
[in LXX: Sng.5:10, 2Ma.11:37 * ;]
of what sort: 1Co.3:13, Gal.2:6, 1Th.1:9, Jas.1:24; τοιοῦτος ὁ., such as, Act.26:29.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: Paul said, “I pray to God, that whether with little or with much, not only you, but also all that hear me today, might become such as I am, except for these…
each man’s work will be revealed. For the Day will declare it, because it is revealed in fire; and the fire itself will test what sort of work each man’s work…
But from those who were reputed to be important—whatever they were, it makes no difference to me; God doesn’t show partiality to man—they, I say, who were…
For they themselves report concerning us what kind of a reception we had from you, and how you turned to God from idols, to serve a living and true God,
for he sees himself, and goes away, and immediately forgets what kind of man he was.
